questions.text: 'नवनिश्चयवाद' की संकल्पना के द्वारा प्रस्तुत की गई ।
questions.text_english: The concept of 'Neodeterminism' was introduced by
questions.solution: Griffith Taylor introduced the concept of 'Neodeterminism' or 'Stop and Go Determinism', which acts as a middle path between environmental determinism and possibilism.

questions.text: मानव भूगोल मानव समाजों और धरातल के बीच संबंधों का संश्लेषित अध्ययन है। मानव भूगोल की यह परिभाषा किसने दी है?
questions.text_english: Human geography is the synthetic study of relationship between human societies and earth's surface. This definition of human geography is given by
questions.solution: The definition of human geography as 'the synthetic study of the relationship between human societies and the earth's surface' was famously given by the French geographer Vidal-de-la-Blache.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक विषय के रूप में 'भूगोल' का मुख्य सरोकार है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following is the core concern of geography as a discipline?

options.A: जनसंख्या वितरण और उसको प्रभावित करने वाले कारकों को समझना ।
options.B: संसाधन-वितरण और उनके उपयोग के बीच संबंध को समझना ।
options.C: पृथ्वी को मानव के आवास और इसकी वहनीयता को समझना ।
options.D: पृथ्वी को प्राकृतिक संसाधनों का घर और उनके आंकलन को समझना ।

options_english.A: To understand population distribution and the factors affecting the same.
options_english.B: To understand the relationship between resource distribution and its utilisation.
options_english.C: To understand the earth as the home of human beings and its sustainability.
options_english.D: To understand the earth as the home of natural resources and their estimation.

questions.solution: Geography, as a study, is fundamentally concerned with understanding the Earth as the home of human beings and ensuring its sustainable use and management.

questions.text: अंतर्देशीय पत्तन से संबंधित निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : (i) ये पत्तन समुद्री तट से दूर अवस्थित होते हैं। (ii) ये पत्तन समुद्र से अंतर्देशीय जल निकायों से जुड़े होते हैं। (iii) ये पत्तन चौरस तल वाले जहाज या बजरे द्वारा गम्य होते हैं। (iv) कोच्चि, अदन और होनोलूलू अंतर्देशीय पत्तन के कुछ उदाहरण हैं।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements regarding inland ports carefully and choose the correct option: (i) These ports are located away from the sea coast. (ii) These ports are linked to sea by inland water bodies. (iii) These ports are accessible by flat bottomed ships or barges. (iv) Kochchi, Aden and Honolulu are some of the examples of inland port.
questions.solution: Inland ports are located away from the sea coast, linked to the sea by a river or a canal. They are accessible only by flat-bottomed ships or barges. Kochi, Aden, and Honolulu are sea ports, not inland ports.

questions.text: नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : अभिकथन (A) : अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार राष्ट्रों के लिए हानिकारक साबित हो सकता है। कारण (R) : इससे अन्य देशों पर निर्भरता बढ़ सकती है, जिससे शोषण हो सकता है।
questions.text_english: Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option: Assertion (A): 'International trade may prove to be detrimental to nations.' Reason (R): 'It may lead to dependence on other nations causing exploitation.'

options.A: दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.A: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is correct explanation of (A).
options_english.B: Both (A) and (R) are correct, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.C: (A) is correct, but (R) is not correct.

questions.solution: Excessive international trade can lead to unhealthy reliance on other nations, which can lead to economic or political exploitation, thus validating both the assertion and the reason.

questions.text: आधुनिक समय में, व्यापार विश्व के आर्थिक संगठनों और राष्ट्रों की _______ से संबंधित है।
questions.text_english: In modern times, trade is the basis of the world's economic organisation and is related to the _______ of nations.
questions.solution: Modern international trade is largely dictated by the foreign trade policies of sovereign nations, which are the basis for economic organizations like the WTO.

questions.text: भारत के निम्नलिखित नगरों को उनके ऐतिहासिक विकास के आधार पर प्राचीनतम से नवीनतम के क्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : (i) चेन्नई (ii) गाँधीनगर (iii) पटना (iv) लखनऊ
questions.text_english: Arrange the following towns of India as per their historical evolution from the oldest to the newest order and choose the correct option: (i) Chennai (ii) Gandhinagar (iii) Patna (iv) Lucknow
questions.solution: Patna (Pataliputra) is the oldest (ancient), followed by Lucknow (medieval), then Chennai (modern/colonial), and finally Gandhinagar (planned capital, post-independence).

questions.text: भारत की नगरीय बस्तियों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : (i) सभी नगरीय बस्तियाँ विनिर्माण के केन्द्र हैं। (ii) सामान्यतः नगरीय बस्तियाँ संहत (सघन) और बड़े आकार की हैं। (iii) ये विविध प्रकार के गैर-कृषि कार्यों में संलग्न हैं। (iv) नगरीय बस्तियों का ग्रामीण बस्तियों के साथ सीधा संबंध होता है।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements regarding urban settlements of India carefully and choose the correct options: (i) All urban settlements are manufacturing centres. (ii) Urban settlements are generally compact and larger in size. (iii) They are engaged in a variety of non-agricultural activities. (iv) The urban settlements have direct relation with rural settlements.
questions.solution: Urban settlements are characterized by compact size and non-agricultural activities. They have functional links with rural areas. Not all urban settlements are manufacturing centers (some are administrative, cultural, etc.).

questions.text: नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : अभिकथन (A) : कृषि में समृद्ध राज्य पंजाब, हरियाणा और पश्चिमी उत्तर प्रदेश भूजल की कमी के संकट का सामना कर रहे हैं। कारण (R) : जल स्तर पुनर्भरण की तुलना में सिंचाई के लिए अधिक भूजल का उपयोग किया जाता है।
questions.text_english: Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option: Assertion (A): 'The agriculturally rich states of Punjab, Haryana and western Uttar Pradesh are facing the crisis of groundwater depletion.' Reason (R): 'More groundwater is utilised for irrigation than water-table recharge.'

options.A: दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं हैं।
options.C: (A) सही नहीं है, लेकिन (R) सही है।
options.D: (A) सही है, लेकिन (R) सही नहीं है।

options_english.A: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is correct reason of (A).
options_english.B: Both (A) and (R) are correct, but (R) is not the correct reason of (A).
options_english.C: (A) is not correct, but (R) is correct.
options_english.D: (A) is correct, but (R) is not correct.

questions.solution: The intense irrigation practices in Punjab, Haryana, and Western UP have led to over-extraction of groundwater, resulting in depletion because the rate of extraction exceeds the natural recharge rate.

questions.text: इंदिरा गांधी नहर परियोजना से संबंधित निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : (i) इंदिरा गांधी नहर परियोजना को 1950 में कँवर सेन द्वारा संकल्पित किया गया था और इसको 1961 में प्रारंभ किया गया था। (ii) नहर सिंचाई की शुरुआत से कमांड क्षेत्र की कृषि अर्थव्यवस्था में उल्लेखनीय परिवर्तन आया है। (iii) नहर सिंचाई के प्रसार से खेती के क्षेत्र और फसल सघनता में वृद्धि हुई है। (iv) ज्वार-बाजरे की परंपरागत फसलों को गेहूँ और चावल आदि ने प्रतिस्थापित कर दिया है।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements related to Indira Gandhi Canal Project carefully and choose the correct option: (i) Indira Gandhi Canal project was conceived by Kanwar Sain in 1950 and it was launched in 1961. (ii) Introduction of canal irrigation has brought perceptible changes in the agricultural economy of the command area. (iii) Spread of canal irrigation has led to increase in cultivated area and crop intensity. (iv) Traditional crops of jowar, bajra has been replaced by rice and wheat etc.
questions.solution: The Indira Gandhi Canal was indeed conceived by Kanwar Sain (1948, not 1950), making (i) partially incorrect depending on sources, but (ii), (iii), and (iv) are factually correct consequences of the project as described in the curriculum.

questions.text: भारत के अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार से संबंधित निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : (i) भारत की एक लंबी तटरेखा है जो तीन तरफ से समुद्र से घिरी हुई है। (ii) भारत के तट पर बड़ी संख्या में सुविकसित पत्तन हैं। (iii) कांडला पत्तन बड़ी मात्रा में लौह अयस्क का निर्यात करता है। (iv) भारी-भरकम वस्तुओं का जलमार्ग द्वारा परिवहन खर्च बहुत सस्ता है।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements related to international trade of India carefully and choose the correct option: (i) India has a long coastline surrounded by ocean from three sides. (ii) Indian coasts have large number of well-developed sea ports. (iii) Kandla port exports huge amount of iron-ore. (iv) The transportation cost by water is very cheap for voluminous items.
questions.solution: India has a long coastline with many ports, and water transport is economical for voluminous goods. However, Kandla is not the primary port for iron-ore exports (that is generally Paradip or Mormugao).

questions.text: ऐसा क्यों है कि झुग्गी बस्तियाँ (slums) सबसे कम विकल्प वाला निवास क्षेत्र है ? सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : (i) इनमें खराब वेंटिलेशन वाले जर्जर घर हैं। (ii) रोशनी और शौचालय जैसी बुनियादी सुविधाएँ मिलना मुश्किल हैं। (iii) स्वास्थ्यकर परिस्थितियाँ और पेयजल अव्यवस्थित हैं । (iv) बेहतर जल-निकासी सुविधाएँ उपलब्ध हैं।
questions.text_english: Why is it that slums are the areas of residence with least choice ? Choose the correct options: (i) They have dilapidated houses with poor ventilation. (ii) The basic facilities like lights and toilets are difficult to get. (iii) Hygienic conditions and drinking water are improper. (iv) Better drainage facilities are available.
questions.solution: Slums are characterized by poor housing, lack of basic amenities, and unhygienic conditions. Better drainage facilities are typically absent in slums.

questions.text: मध्य प्रदेश के झाबुआ जिले में जल संभर प्रबंधन कार्यक्रम निम्नलिखित में से किस मंत्रालय द्वारा वित्तपोषित है ?
questions.text_english: The watershed management programme in Jhabua district of Madhya Pradesh is funded by which one of the following ministries?
questions.solution: The watershed management programs, including the one in Jhabua, are typically funded and implemented under the Ministry of Rural Development, as part of efforts to improve rural livelihoods and water security.

questions.text: भारत में पन्ना, पाड़ा, पाली, नगला, ढाँणी आदि स्थानीय नाम निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रकार की ग्रामीण बस्तियों के उदाहरण हैं?
questions.text_english: Local names like Panna, Para, Palli, Nagla, Dhani etc. are examples of which of the following types of rural settlements in India?
questions.solution: These local names in various parts of India represent 'Hamleted' settlements, which are small clusters separated from the main village.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किस श्रेणी की वस्तुओं के निर्यात में 2015-16 से 2016-17 तक अधिकतम गिरावट दर्ज की गई है ?

questions.solution: Based on the provided table, 'Other items' dropped from 1.1% in 2015-16 to 0.5% in 2016-17, representing a significant proportional decline compared to other categories.

questions.solution: Based on the table, 'Agriculture and Allied Products' increased from 9.9% in 2010-11 to 12.3% in 2016-17, showing a clear growth trend.

questions.solution: According to the table, 'Manufactured Goods' consistently showed an increasing trend (67.4% -> 68.0% -> 72.9% -> 73.6%) across the years listed.

questions.text:
दिए गए अनुच्छेद को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और उसके नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर लिखिए :

आखेट एवं भोजन संग्रह
मानव सभ्यता के आरंभिक युग में आदिमकालीन मानव अपने जीवन-निर्वाह के लिए अपने समीप के वातावरण पर निर्भर रहता था । उसका जीवन-निर्वाह दो प्रकार के कार्यों द्वारा होता था (क) पशुओं का आखेट करके और (ख) अपने समीप के जंगलों से खाने योग्य जंगली पौधे एवं कंद-मूल आदि को एकत्रित करके ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions given below:

Hunting and Food Gathering
In the early ages of human civilization, primitive humans depended on their immediate environment for their subsistence. Their subsistence was based on two types of activities: (a) hunting animals, and (b) gathering edible wild plants, roots, and tubers from the nearby forests.

sub_questions.text: आदिमकालीन मानव अपने जीवन-निर्वाह के लिए किस पर निर्भर था ?
sub_questions.text_english: On what did primitive humans depend for their subsistence?
sub_questions.solution: Primitive humans depended on their immediate environment for their subsistence in the early stages of human civilization.

sub_questions.text: जीवन-निर्वाह के लिए आदिमकालीन मानव द्वारा किए जाने वाले किन्हीं दो कार्यों के नाम लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the names of any two activities performed by primitive humans for subsistence.

sub_questions.solution: The two activities performed by primitive humans for subsistence were hunting animals and gathering edible wild plants, roots, and tubers.

questions.text: स्थानांतरित कृषि (झूमिंग) की किन्हीं तीन विशेषताओं का वर्णन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Describe any three characteristics of shifting cultivation (Jhuming).

key_points: Practice of clearing forests through fire.
Cultivation of crops for a short period until soil fertility decreases.
Shifting to a new plot after exhausting the current one.
key_points_hindi: वनस्पति को जलाकर भूमि साफ करना।
कुछ वर्षों तक फसल उगाना जब तक उर्वरता बनी रहे।
उर्वरता खत्म होने पर नया भूखंड चुनना।

questions.solution: Shifting cultivation, also known as Jhuming, is primarily practiced in tropical forest regions. First, farmers clear a patch of forest land by cutting and burning the vegetation. Second, they cultivate the land for a short period until the soil fertility decreases. Third, once the fertility is exhausted, the community shifts to a new piece of land, allowing the abandoned plot to regenerate naturally.

questions.text: जनसंख्या घनत्व से क्या तात्पर्य है ? भारत के संदर्भ में इसे कैसे निकाला जाता है ?
questions.text_english: What is meant by population density? How is it calculated in the context of India?

key_points: Ratio of population to land area.
Formula: Total Population / Total Land Area.
key_points_hindi: जनसंख्या और भूमि क्षेत्रफल का अनुपात।

questions.solution: Population density refers to the ratio of the number of people to the land area they occupy. It gives a measurement of how crowded or sparsely populated a specific region is. In the context of India, it is calculated by dividing the total population of a region by its total land area, expressed as the number of persons per square kilometer. This metric helps in understanding the pressure of population on land resources.
questions.chapter: Population: Distribution, Density, Growth and Composition

questions.text: प्रवास के किन्हीं तीन आर्थिक कारणों का उल्लेख कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Mention any three economic reasons for migration.

key_points: Lack of economic development in rural areas.
key_points_hindi: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में आर्थिक विकास की कमी।

questions.solution: Economic factors are the most significant drivers of migration. First, many people migrate from rural to urban areas in search of better employment opportunities that are not available in their native places. Second, the lure of higher wages and better standards of living in industrial centers prompts migration. Third, limited economic development, such as lack of industrialization or agricultural job stagnation in rural areas, often acts as a push factor, forcing individuals to move to cities for better economic prospects.

questions.text: वायु प्रदूषण के किन्हीं तीन मुख्य स्रोतों को स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Explain any three main sources of air pollution.

key_points: Burning of fossil fuels and solid waste.
key_points_hindi: जीवाश्म ईंधन और ठोस कचरे का जलना।

questions.solution: Air pollution is caused by the release of harmful substances into the atmosphere. The first major source is industrial emissions, where factories release smoke, chemicals, and particulates. Second, vehicular exhaust from cars, trucks, and buses significantly contributes to pollutants like carbon monoxide and nitrogen oxides in urban areas. Third, the burning of fossil fuels for electricity generation and heating, as well as the burning of agricultural waste or solid garbage, adds large amounts of carbon dioxide and hazardous smoke to the environment.

questions.text: भारत में स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं के वितरण की किन्हीं तीन समस्याओं का वर्णन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Describe any three problems of distribution of health services in India.

key_points: Shortage of medical personnel in rural areas.
High cost of private medical care.
key_points_hindi: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में चिकित्सा कर्मियों की कमी।
निजी चिकित्सा सेवाओं की उच्च लागत।

questions.solution: The distribution of health services in India faces significant challenges. Firstly, there is a stark urban-rural divide where modern medical infrastructure is concentrated in cities, leaving rural areas underserved. Secondly, there is a chronic shortage of qualified medical personnel, such as doctors and nurses, willing to work in remote or backward areas. Thirdly, the high cost of private medical services makes essential healthcare inaccessible to a large section of the economically disadvantaged population, despite the existence of public health systems.

questions.text: विश्व में जनसंख्या के वितरण और घनत्व को प्रभावित करने वाले किन्हीं पाँच भौगोलिक कारकों का विस्तारपूर्वक वर्णन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Describe in detail any five geographical factors affecting the distribution and density of population in the world.

key_points: Landforms (prefer flat plains over rugged mountains).

questions.solution: Population distribution and density are influenced by several geographical factors. Water availability is the most crucial; people prefer to live near rivers and lakes for drinking, irrigation, and transport. Landforms significantly affect settlement patterns, with flat plains and fertile valleys supporting dense populations, whereas rugged mountains and hilly regions are sparsely populated. Favorable climate, characterized by moderate temperatures and adequate rainfall, encourages settlements, while extreme climates like desert or arctic conditions discourage them. Soils are vital, especially for agricultural societies, as fertile soils can support high population densities. Finally, areas with rich natural resources, such as coal or mineral deposits, or those conducive to industrial development, attract people and lead to high population concentrations. These factors combined create the uneven pattern of global population distribution.

questions.text: मानव विकास के तीन मूलभूत क्षेत्र कौन-से हैं ? 'मानव विकास के स्तंभों' का विस्तारपूर्वक वर्णन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: What are the three fundamental areas of human development? Describe the 'pillars of human development' in detail.

key_points: Three areas: Health, Education, Access to Resources.
key_points_hindi: तीन क्षेत्र: स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा, संसाधनों तक पहुँच।

questions.solution: Human development focuses on broadening people's choices. The three fundamental areas of human development are access to resources, education, and health. The concept is supported by four key pillars. The first pillar is Equity, which means making equal access to opportunities available to all, regardless of caste, gender, or race. The second pillar is Sustainability, ensuring continuity in the availability of opportunities by using resources wisely for future generations. The third pillar is Productivity, which relates to human labor productivity, which can be improved through education and better health. The fourth pillar is Empowerment, which means having the power to make choices, which comes from increasing freedom and capability. By strengthening these pillars, nations can ensure comprehensive development of their human capital.

questions.text: भारत में विनिर्माण उद्योगों के वर्गीकरण को आधारों के साथ स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Explain the classification of manufacturing industries in India with their basis.

key_points: Based on Output/Use (Basic goods, Consumer goods).
Based on Ownership (Public, Private, Joint, Cooperative).
key_points_hindi: कच्चे माल के आधार पर (कृषि आधारित, खनिज आधारित)।
स्वामित्व के आधार पर (सार्वजनिक, निजी, संयुक्त, सहकारी)।

questions.solution: Manufacturing industries in India are classified based on several criteria to manage and understand their scale and impact. First, based on size, industries are categorized as small-scale (labor-intensive, less capital) or large-scale (capital-intensive, high technology). Second, based on the source of raw materials, they are divided into agro-based industries (like cotton, sugar), mineral-based (like iron and steel), and forest-based. Third, based on the nature of their output, they are classified into basic goods industries (providing materials for other industries) and consumer goods industries (producing goods for direct use). Finally, based on ownership, they are classified as public sector (government-owned), private sector (owned by individuals), joint sector (jointly owned), and cooperative sector (owned by producers).

questions.text: भारत में जल प्रदूषण के कारणों और इसके बचाव के उपायों का विस्तारपूर्वक वर्णन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Describe in detail the causes of water pollution in India and measures for its prevention.

key_points: Causes: Industrial waste, sewage disposal, agricultural runoff (pesticides/fertilizers).
Measures: Treating industrial effluents, managing sewage, sustainable agriculture, public awareness.
key_points_hindi: कारण: औद्योगिक कचरा, सीवेज निपटान, कृषि अपवाह (कीटनाशक/उर्वरक)।
उपाय: औद्योगिक अपशिष्ट का उपचार, सीवेज प्रबंधन, टिकाऊ कृषि, जन जागरूकता।

questions.solution: Water pollution in India is a critical environmental concern primarily caused by industrial effluents being discharged directly into rivers, untreated sewage from urban areas, and excessive use of chemicals like pesticides and fertilizers in agriculture, which runoff into water bodies. To prevent this, comprehensive measures are needed. First, industries must be mandated to treat their waste before disposal. Second, urban sewage treatment plants (STPs) need to be expanded to ensure waste is processed before reaching water sources. Third, sustainable agricultural practices, such as reducing the reliance on chemical fertilizers and pesticides, can significantly decrease runoff pollution. Finally, strict enforcement of environmental regulations and increasing public awareness regarding water cleanliness are essential for long-term conservation and restoration of Indian water bodies.

questions.text: सड़क परिवहन की किन्हीं पाँच लाभों का वर्णन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Describe any five advantages of road transport.

key_points_hindi: दूरदराज के इलाकों को जोड़ता है।

questions.solution: Road transport plays a vital role in connectivity and trade. The first major advantage is door-to-door service, as it can reach locations where other transport modes cannot. Second, it offers great flexibility in terms of routes and timings compared to railways or airlines. Third, road transport is highly cost-effective and suitable for short to medium-distance travel of both passengers and freight. Fourth, construction and maintenance of roads are easier and less capital-intensive compared to rail or airport infrastructure. Fifth, roads are the only viable means to connect remote and inaccessible areas with urban centers, thereby facilitating rural integration and development.
